info.name: Massage booking API
info.description:
Requests of the booking API (OpenAPI 3.1: `services/booking/src/openapi/document.ts`) and the Firebase REST sign-in used to get ID tokens. Instructions: `docs/postman.md`.

**Real operations.** Requests run against the environment you select (staging): ⚠️ requests change data or send emails. Send them one by one; **do not run this collection or a folder with the Collection Runner**.

Secrets (Web API key, passwords, tokens) live only in the **current values** of your local environment. Scripts never print them.

item.name: 1. Firebase sign-in (Firebase REST, not this API)
item.description:
Sign-in happens in **Firebase Authentication**; this API has no sign-in routes. These requests go to `identitytoolkit.googleapis.com` and `securetoken.googleapis.com` with the Web API key of the Firebase project.

- Tokens are stored per role (`client…`, `admin…`, `guest…`), so one sign-in never overwrites another role.
- Tokens are saved only into the **current values** of the selected environment, after HTTP 200 and a non-empty token. Nothing is printed to the console.
- The admin requests only sign in to an existing account. **The collection never assigns the admin role** (the owner does it with a command, outside the API).
- ⚠️ requests marked SEND verification email send a real email.
- **Google sign-in is not part of this collection**: it needs the browser flow of the frontend (popup/redirect, authorized domain, CORS). It is a separate future browser check; do not imitate it with email/password.

exec: // Builds the JSON body from the environment; JSON.stringify escapes any character of the password.
console.warn("Request skipped. Set the current values of firebaseWebApiKey, clientEmail and clientPassword.");
pm.request.body.update({ mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ email, password, returnSecureToken: true }), options: { raw: { language: "json" } } });
// Saves the client tokens into the CURRENT values of the selected environment (local),
// only after HTTP 200 with non-empty strings. Token values are never printed.
const field = (key) => (body !== null && typeof body === "object" && typeof body[key] === "string" ? body[key] : "");
// The token must be issued for the Firebase project of this environment (otherwise: wrong Web API key).
const saved = pm.response.code === 200 && idToken.length > 0 && refreshToken.length > 0 && hasEnvironment && audience === project;
pm.test("non-empty ID token and refresh token in the response", () => pm.expect(idToken.length > 0 && refreshToken.length > 0).to.equal(true));
pm.test("token issued for project " + project, () => pm.expect(audience === project).to.equal(true));
pm.test(saved ? "tokens saved to " + ID_VAR + " / " + REFRESH_VAR : "tokens NOT saved (previous values kept)", () => pm.expect(saved).to.equal(true));
const error = body !== null && typeof body === "object" && body.error && typeof body.error.message === "string" ? body.error.message.slice(0, 120) : "";

item.name: 3. Client (clientIdToken)
item.description:
Requests of a registered client. Bearer token: `{{clientIdToken}}` (skipped while it is empty). To book, the client needs a verified email, a name and a phone (`bookingReadiness.blockers`).

⚠️ = changes data. Booking emails are off on staging; when they are switched on, creating, rescheduling and cancelling send emails.

const profile = body && body.profile ? body.profile : null;

request.description: POST /api/me/sync (syncProfile) without a body: creates or refreshes the profile from the ID token. Saves `profile.id` into `clientProfileId`. Run it again after a token refresh to pick up `emailVerified: true`. Sends no email (the marketing checkbox is not sent).
GET /api/me (getProfile). Read-only.
⚠️ PATCH /api/me (updateProfile). Changes the profile. Invented example values; replace them with test data.
⚠️ POST /api/me/sessions/revoke (revokeSessions). Revokes ALL Firebase refresh tokens of this account: the saved client tokens stop working (`401 SESSION_REVOKED`), sign in again afterwards.

item.name: 5. Admin (adminIdToken)
item.description:
Verified administrator only. Bearer token: `{{adminIdToken}}`. The collection does **not** assign the role: until the owner assigns it, these requests answer `403`.

⚠️ = changes data. Booking emails are off on staging; when they are on, cancelling by the studio emails the client.

GET /api/admin/schedule (getSchedule). Read-only.

⚠️ PUT /api/admin/schedule/weekly (replaceWeeklySchedule). **Replaces the whole weekly schedule**. Invented example hours: edit them before sending. Refused with `409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT` when active bookings would fall outside.

item.name: 7. Marketing — DISABLED on staging (404 NOT_FOUND)
item.description:
**Marketing is switched off on staging**: every request here answers `404 NOT_FOUND` until `ENABLE_MARKETING_SUBSCRIPTION` is enabled with Brevo. Kept for later.

⚠️ When marketing is enabled, the subscribe requests send a real confirmation email.
